reviews.title: I purchased a esim for thailand and to…
reviews.body:
I purchased a esim for thailand and to start I encountered afew problems 
I contacted thier webchat and to be honest it didn't help me to rectify my concern.
I thought that was the end of it and thought oh well I've lost my £20.
Last night I received a phone call from lebara and I can honestly say in all the years I have had to deal with various problems on the phone the lady on the call was truly sympathetic and very understanding. 
She said she would refund me my £20 and throughly apologized for the problems that I had encountered. She must be a credit to the company
It's not just the refund of the £20 its the way I was reassured. To me this very rare especially in England nowadays.

reviews.title: Reccomended, BUT
reviews.body:
Bought an 8day sim for France and it all worked great for internet searching and especially for Google maps navigation in a hire car. I was surprising how little data we actually used, only 3GB over whole week including a thousand miles of satnav!
*BUT* Be aware that when activated the sim duration is per day and starts at midnight so if you arrive abroad and activate the sim at say 10pm you have lost 22hrs of the sim plan. This is NOT stated anywhere in the T&Cs
This caught us out with no data while trying to sort travel plans coming home as we thought it was 8 days from actual time of activation.
